backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor serving as a placeholder backend canister.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence record describing routing changes requiring all public and admin pages to live under /echofields, including referenced frontend files.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of major frontend files describing routing, pages, components, hooks, and entry setup.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind and OKLCH-based global styles defining light/dark theme variables and base element styling.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML shell mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Defines TanStack Router routes all under /echofields with a root redirect and layout including header, footer, and theming.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component showing attribution and a link to caffeine.ai with icons.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Header with site branding and conditional navigation to the /echofields/admin page.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor and invalidates dependent queries on changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context and provider managing Internet Identity authentication, status, and stored identities.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for listing, fetching, creating, and deleting clues using mock data until backend methods exist.
frontend/src/index.css: Alternate Tailwind/OKLCH theme definitions for global styles with light/dark mode support.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point initializing QueryClient, InternetIdentityProvider, global styles, and rendering App.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin interface that handles Internet Identity login and provides forms to create and delete clues using query hooks. Shows login prompt when unauthenticated and full management UI when logged in.
frontend/src/pages/CluePage.tsx: Loads and displays a single clue based on the URL parameter, showing loading and not-found states. Provides navigation back to the main Echofields page.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Public landing page introducing the Echofields experience with feature cards and instructions. Includes a CTA linking to the admin portal.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending theme colors, radii, shadows, animations, and enabling plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing implemented and pending feature requests for a clue-based site with admin management and URL-driven progression.
